setup.run: python3 -m pip install 'uv==0.8.13' && uv sync --frozen --extra dev && npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund

dev.reason: Runtime startup is intentionally model/workload-specific; there is no single repository-wide development daemon command that can truthfully select a model/backend for every checkout.

check.run: uv run --frozen ruff check src/ tests/ --select E9,F63,F7,F82

smoke.requires: An already running real Local LLM Server with an unambiguous default runtime, or pass --model explicitly.

package.reason: The Python wheel/sdist distributables and their uniquely identified bundle are produced atomically by the canonical build operation; a second packaging command would duplicate the artifact source of truth.

stop.reason: The supported local server is foreground-owned rather than a detached repository daemon. Its owning process/signal path performs shutdown; deterministic E2E additionally verifies the owned listener and temp state are gone.

clean.run: rm -rf build dist src/*.egg-info .pytest_cache .ruff_cache playwright-report test-results

remote_preflight.trigger: Open or update a same-repository pull request targeting dev; GitHub pull_request workflows run deterministic validation on the exact PR head, and failed jobs may be rerun through GitHub Actions.

end_to_end.implementation_state: Implemented for the deterministic Studio/product boundary: Playwright owns a run-scoped synthetic evaluation workspace, CI performs an always-run residue check, and failure traces/screenshots have seven-day retention. Built-wheel and representative-hardware evidence remain distinct stronger environments.

build_identity.implementation_state: Implemented by scripts/build_artifacts.py: product version, unique UTC/UUID build ID, source revision, dirty state and lineage are recorded in the promoted build manifest and bundle identity.

artifact_lifecycle.implementation_state: Implemented for wheel/sdist builds and tagged releases: staging/promote, manifest, SHA-256 inventory, bounded local retention, seven-day CI handoff retention and fail-closed existing release/tag behavior are present.

build_delta.implementation_state: Implemented by scripts/build_artifacts.py and bundled with every promoted build.

local_runtime.implementation_state: Loopback/foreground/readiness/graceful shutdown are product behavior; deterministic E2E verifies its owned fixture listener closes, while representative real-runtime lifecycle evidence remains a distinct hardware/environment claim.

ephemeral_resources.implementation_state: Implemented for deterministic E2E run-owned evaluation/temp state with ownership-checked deletion and independent post-run verification.
